attributes._cssText: :root { --bg: #0a0808; --dim: #4b4340; --fg: #ece4d6; --accent: #c9151e; }html, body { background: var(--bg); height: 100%; color: var(--fg); margin: 0px; font: 11px / 1.4 ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; overflow: hidden; }body { display: flex; }#view { flex: 1 1 0%; place-items: center; min-width: 0px; display: grid; }#stage { position: relative; }#game { width: 100%; height: 100%; image-rendering: pixelated; cursor: none; display: block; }#crt { pointer-events: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; position: absolute; inset: 0px; }#stage.glass::after { content: ""; z-index: 5; pointer-events: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07) 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 3px), radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 45%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 55%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 100%); position: absolute; inset: 0px; }#status, #help { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 75%, transparent); pointer-events: none; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 2px 6px; position: absolute; left: 10px; }#status { top: 10px; }#board { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent); pointer-events: none; white-space: pre; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 14px; position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; }#stage.small #status { white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: calc(100% - 32px); overflow: hidden; }#stage.small #board { font-size: 11px; top: 32px; left: 10px; right: auto; }#board:empty, #menu:empty, #stage.level #help { display: none; }#menu { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 94%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); white-space: pre; pointer-events: none; padding: 14px 20px; font-size: 13px; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }#menu b, #board b, #board .bounce, #board .warn { color: var(--accent); }#board .run { color: var(--fg); }#help { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 65%, var(--bg)); white-space: pre; top: 34px; }#caption { box-sizing: border-box; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent); text-align: center; pointer-events: none; width: 90%; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; position: absolute; top: 7%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%); }#caption:empty { display: none; }#caption i { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 65%, var(--bg)); margin-top: 3px; font-style: normal; display: block; }#caption i.good { color: var(--fg); }#caption i.slip { color: var(--accent); }#caption b { color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 0.1em; font-size: 15px; display: block; }#tuning { box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--bg); border-left: 1px solid var(--dim); flex: 0 0 auto; width: 330px; height: 100%; padding: 10px; display: none; overflow-y: auto; }#tuning.open { display: block; }#tuning .head { color: var(--fg); justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; }#tuning summary { color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin: 8px 0px 4px; }#tuning label { grid-template-columns: 1fr 44px; align-items: center; gap: 0px 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; display: grid; }#tuning label span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg) 65%, var(--bg)); grid-column: 1 / 3; }#tuning input { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); margin: 0px; }#tuning output { text-align: right; }#tuning output.changed { color: var(--accent); }#tuning button { font: inherit; }

childNodes.textContent: RHYTHM 1/5 SWITCHBACK  ·  ASSAULT  ·  NORMAL 100%  ·  R menu  ·  H tutorial

move   WASD / left stick
aim    mouse / right stick
A      Space: tap = roll, hold = sprint,
       at a wall = slide to it
       just before the wall = bounce to another
fire   click / RT
reload E / RB, again in the white = perfect
cover  pressed to a wall, aim across it to fire over
enemy  a laser locks, then a burst follows it:
       get behind a wall, or roll through
menu   R / Y   (levels, jazz courses, new room)
H      tutorial      - =  speed: easy to hard (LB)
Reach: how far away a wall grabs you (px)
Bounce window: how close to the wall before A or a flick works (px)
Crunch: time stuck after hitting a wall (s)
Crunch: screen shake on that hit
Aim assist: how far off the stick may point (radians)
How squarely you must face the wall (0 to 1)
Speed kept after a cancel (0 to 1)
Time to start the next slide after a cancel (s)
Hold this long to sprint instead of roll (s)
Active reload: where the sweet spot starts (0 to 1)
Fire-rate bonus after a perfect reload
How far away an enemy can see you (px)
How close an enemy comes once it can see you (px)
How long the laser holds still before the burst (s)
Time between rounds in a burst (s)
Time each kill takes off the clock (s)
Your health: hits you can take
Time you are safe after a hit (s)
Time unhurt before a health point returns (s)
